_extraction_notes.revenue_line_mapping: Oracle's GAAP income statement reports four revenue lines: 'Cloud services and license support' (combined cloud services + on-premise license support), 'Cloud license and on-premise license' (new license revenue), 'Hardware', and 'Services'. In this schema they are mapped as revenue.cloud = 'Cloud services and license support' and revenue.software = 'Cloud license and on-premise license', using Oracle's own reported figures verbatim (no re-allocation or estimation).
_extraction_notes.capex_sign_convention: capex_quarter and capex figures are stored as positive magnitudes (spend), consistent with the source press releases' Free Cash Flow tables. free_cash_flow_quarter = operating_cash_flow_quarter - capex_quarter.
_extraction_notes.quarterly_cash_flow_derivation: Oracle's Q2, Q3, and Q4 (and full-year) press releases present GAAP cash flow statements on a year-to-date (cumulative fiscal-year) basis, not discrete-quarter. Discrete quarterly operating cash flow and capex for Q2-Q4 FY2022 were derived by subtracting the prior cumulative period (from the prior quarter's own 8-K Exhibit 99.1) from the current cumulative period, all sourced from Oracle's own SEC filings. The Q1 FY2022 three-month figures (OCF $5,391M; capex $1,062M, from the Q1 FY2022 8-K Exhibit 99.1, accession 0001564590-21-047736) were used only as the subtrahend for Q2 and are recorded under _fy2022q1_cash_flow_reference; no full Q1 record is produced. Cross-check: Q1 reference + three derived quarters of operating cash flow (5,391 + (-3,682) + 3,845 + 3,985 = 9,539) equals the FY2022 Year Ended May 31, 2022 GAAP operating cash flow of $9,539M exactly; capex (1,062 + 925 + 1,101 + 1,423 = 4,511) equals FY2022 capex of $4,511M exactly; resulting FY free cash flow of $5,028M matches the Free Cash Flow - Trailing 4-Quarters table printed in the Q4 exhibit ($5,028M) exactly. Secondary cross-check: combining these discrete quarters with the FY2021 quarterly figures printed in the prior-year columns reproduces the trailing-4-quarter OCF/capex printed in the Q2 exhibit (10,255 / 3,118) and the Q3 exhibit (10,396 / 3,805) exactly.
_extraction_notes.da_derivation: Each quarter's 'da' object is taken from the two GAAP cash-flow-statement adjustment lines 'Depreciation' and 'Amortization of intangible assets'. Because Q2-Q4 exhibits print these cumulatively (six, nine and twelve months), discrete quarters were derived by the same subtraction method as operating cash flow; the cumulative figures as printed are retained in da.cumulative_as_printed. Cross-check: depreciation 454 + 459 + 496 + 563 = 1,972 = FY2022 Year Ended May 31, 2022 depreciation; amortization 303 + 300 + 279 + 268 = 1,150 = FY2022 amortization of intangible assets (which also equals the FY2022 income-statement 'Amortization of intangible assets' line of $1,150M). Note: the derived Q2 amortization from the cash-flow statement (300) differs by $1M from the Q2 three-month income-statement line (299) because Oracle's cumulative six-month figure (603) does not equal the sum of the two discrete income-statement quarters (303 + 299 = 602) due to rounding; the cash-flow-derived figure is recorded in 'da' and the income-statement figure in 'opex', each as printed/derived from its own statement.
_extraction_notes.rpo_disclosure: None of the FY2022 Exhibit 99.1 earnings press releases (Q2, Q3, Q4) discloses Remaining Performance Obligations, in any precision. rpo.total and rpo.yoy_change are therefore null for all three quarters (not estimated).
_extraction_notes.guidance_disclosure: Oracle's Exhibit 99.1 earnings press releases for Q2-Q4 FY2022 do not contain a quantified forward-guidance table (no next-quarter revenue growth %, cloud growth %, or non-GAAP EPS range). Quantified guidance was given verbally on the earnings conference calls (separate documents, not part of these 8-K exhibits) and was NOT extracted here to preserve strict SEC-filing sourcing. Qualitative forward-looking CEO commentary contained in each exhibit is quoted in guidance_issued._note.
_extraction_notes.preferred_dividends: Oracle has no preferred stock outstanding in FY2022; preferred_dividends is 0 in all periods and net_income_common equals net_income.
_extraction_notes.litigation_charge_fy2022: The large FY2022 litigation-related charge was recorded in Q2 FY2022 (three months ended November 30, 2021), NOT Q3. Oracle printed it in the GAAP operating-expense line 'Acquisition related and other' ($4,667M for the quarter), with footnote (2) stating the line 'included the impact of litigation related charges totaling $4.7 billion'; the release text attributes it to 'the payment of a judgment related to a ten year old dispute surrounding former CEO Mark Hurd's employment'. It produced a Q2 GAAP operating loss of $(824)M, a net loss of $(1,247)M and a diluted loss per share of $(0.46); it was excluded from non-GAAP measures (Appendix A). In this schema it sits inside opex.restructuring_and_other for FY2022Q2 (4,667 + 32 restructuring = 4,699), and the components are broken out in the quarter's top-level 'restructuring_and_other' object. Q3 FY2022 contains no litigation charge in operating expenses (Acquisition related and other = $20M); Q3's notable non-recurring item was a $(315)M GAAP 'Non-operating expenses, net', which the release attributes primarily to a decline in the share price of Oxford Nanopore and an operating loss at Ampere (stated to have lowered Q3 EPS by about $0.05). Recorded as printed.
_extraction_notes.stockholders_equity_sign: Oracle reported a stockholders' deficit at every FY2022 quarter-end shown here, driven by share repurchases ($16.2B in FY2022) and the Q2 litigation loss: balance_sheet.stockholders_equity is recorded with the sign as printed, i.e. negative: (9,658) at Nov 30, 2021; (8,211) at Feb 28, 2022; (5,768) at May 31, 2022. The balance sheet caption is 'Stockholders' (Deficit) Equity'.
_extraction_notes.tax_provision_sign: tax_provision is negative when Oracle records a provision for income taxes and positive when it records a benefit. FY2022Q2 shows a GAAP income tax BENEFIT of $249M (printed as 'Benefit from (provision for) income taxes 249'), so tax_provision = +249 for that quarter; Q3 and Q4 are provisions and are negative.
_extraction_notes.diluted_shares_fy2022q2: Because Q2 FY2022 was a GAAP net loss, GAAP diluted weighted-average shares equal basic shares (2,694M); footnote (6) states 91 million shares related to employee stock plans were excluded as anti-dilutive. Oracle's non-GAAP diluted EPS of $1.21 was computed on 2,785M diluted shares (2,694 + 91), as printed in the reconciliation table. gaap.diluted_shares records the GAAP figure (2,694); the non-GAAP share count is recorded in non_gaap._note for that quarter.
_extraction_notes.quarterly_vs_annual_rounding: fiscal_year_annual.FY2022 is taken verbatim from the Year Ended May 31, 2022 columns of the Q4 exhibit, not summed from quarters. For reference, the four discrete GAAP income-statement quarters (Q1 as printed in the Q1 exhibit: revenue 9,728 / operating income 3,427 / net income 2,457; plus Q2-Q4 above) sum to revenue 42,441, operating income 10,928 and net income 6,718, i.e. $1-2M above the printed annual figures (42,440 / 10,926 / 6,717). This is Oracle's own rounding of each quarter to the nearest $ million; the exhibits state 'The sum of the quarterly information presented may vary from the year-to-date information presented due to rounding.' Non-GAAP net income sums exactly (2,944 + 3,380 + 3,102 + 4,235 = 13,661). The cash-flow and D&A quarterly derivations sum to the annual figures exactly by construction.
_extraction_notes.july_2022_item_2_02_8k: An additional Item 2.02 8-K dated July 8, 2022 (accession 0001193125-22-191296, Exhibit 99.1 d331231dex991.htm) was inspected: it is an Oracle CloudWorld press release restating Q4 FY2022 cloud revenue growth headline figures (total cloud $2.9B, IaaS $792M, Fusion ERP $569M, NetSuite ERP $574M) and does not revise any financial statement figure; it was not used as a source for any value here.

source.title: Oracle Q2 FY2022 Earnings Press Release (Exhibit 99.1 to Form 8-K)

revenue._note: cloud = 'Cloud services and license support'; software = 'Cloud license and on-premise license' (Oracle's own line labels).

opex._note: restructuring_and_other = 'Acquisition related and other' ($4,667M, which per footnote (2) 'included the impact of litigation related charges totaling $4.7 billion' - the judgment payment in the former-CEO Mark Hurd employment dispute) + 'Restructuring' ($32M), Oracle's two separate GAAP lines, combined per schema. The litigation charge drove the GAAP operating loss of $(824)M.

gaap._note: GAAP quarter is a loss: 'OPERATING (LOSS) INCOME (824)', '(LOSS) INCOME BEFORE INCOME TAXES (1,496)', 'Benefit from (provision for) income taxes 249' (a benefit, hence positive tax_provision), 'NET (LOSS) INCOME (1,247)', diluted loss per share $(0.46) on 2,694M shares (anti-dilutive 91M shares excluded).

non_gaap._note: Non-GAAP diluted EPS of $1.21 is computed on 2,785M diluted shares (GAAP 2,694M + 91M dilutive shares that were anti-dilutive for the GAAP loss), as printed in the reconciliation table. Check: 3,380 / 2,785 = 1.214.

balance_sheet._note: short_term_debt = 'Notes payable, current'; long_term_debt = 'Notes payable and other borrowings, non-current'. stockholders_equity is a deficit, printed as 'Stockholders' (Deficit) Equity (9,658)'.

cash_flow._note: Derived: Q2 exhibit reports cash flow on a six-months-ended Nov 30, 2021 cumulative basis (OCF $1,709M; capex $1,987M). Q2-only = six-month cumulative minus Q1's reported three-month figures (OCF $5,391M; capex $1,062M) from the Q1 FY2022 8-K Exhibit 99.1 (accession 0001564590-21-047736). The negative Q2 operating cash flow reflects the $4.7B litigation judgment payment. Cross-check: trailing-4-quarter OCF printed in this exhibit ($10,255M) = FY2021 OCF 15,887 - Q1 FY2021 5,953 - Q2 FY2021 1,388 + Q1 FY2022 5,391 + Q2 FY2022 (3,682), reconciles exactly.

da._note: Derived from the cash-flow statement: six months ended Nov 30, 2021 (Depreciation $913M; Amortization of intangible assets $603M) minus Q1 FY2022 three-month figures (Depreciation $454M; Amortization $303M) from the Q1 8-K Exhibit 99.1. Derived Q2 amortization (300) differs by $1M from the Q2 income-statement amortization line (299) due to rounding in Oracle's cumulative figure (303 + 299 = 602 vs 603 printed).

restructuring_and_other._note: Acquisition related and other ($4,667M) includes the $4.7 billion litigation related charges per footnote (2) of the income statement; Restructuring ($32M) is employee severance and other exit costs. Both excluded from non-GAAP measures.

rpo.note_en: Remaining Performance Obligations are not disclosed anywhere in the Q2 FY2022 Exhibit 99.1 press release; left null rather than estimated.
rpo.note_es: Las Obligaciones de Desempeno Restantes no se revelan en ninguna parte del comunicado de resultados del 2T AF2022 (Anexo 99.1); se deja en nulo en lugar de estimarse.

guidance_issued._note: No quantified forward guidance is contained in this Exhibit 99.1 press release. The only forward-looking commentary is qualitative: CEO Safra Catz said the infrastructure and applications cloud businesses (growing 22%) 'are approaching $11 billion in annualized revenue' and that the Gen2 infrastructure businesses 'are growing even faster - and accelerating'; backward-looking remarks note Q2 non-GAAP EPS beat guidance by $0.10 and constant-currency revenue beat guidance by $200 million. Also announced: the board increased the share repurchase authorization by $10 billion.
